addons.name: MCP for 4SEF
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for 4SEF: restore or replace an article's address in one call, audit alias drift and trashed-duplicate collisions, and purge or check URLs.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Requires 4SEF, purchased from Weeblr.

advisory.title: Address changes are dry runs until you confirm; 4SEO is reported, not changed
advisory.message: set_forsef_article_url and purge_forsef_urls only return a plan until you pass dry_run: false. An address held by another article is taken over only with on_collision "take_over_trashed", and only when that article is trashed or deleted; a live owner always refuses. The add-on adds the 301 from the old address itself, but it does not edit 4SEO's records (canonical, sitemap, custom meta) for a moved address. It lists them so you can update them with the 4SEO add-on. Tested on 4SEF 4.0.0.747 with Joomla 6.2.

addons.name: MCP for 4SEO
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for 4SEO meta tags, redirects, JSON-LD, sitemap, and Business Profile management.
addons.notes: Paid add-on — install via Extensions → Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow.

addons.name: MCP for AcyMailing
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for AcyMailing: lists, subscribers, campaign drafts, test sends, guarded queueing, stats and an Events Booking sync check.
addons.notes: Free add-on - install it straight from this catalog. Covers everything AcyMailing Starter can do and works on every edition. Scheduling, detailed stats, segments, automations and follow-ups are Essential and Enterprise features and are in the separate MCP for AcyMailing Essential & Enterprise add-on.

advisory.title: Install AcyMailing itself from the Joomla admin, not over MCP
advisory.message: AcyMailing's own installer calls Joomla's router, which does not exist under the API application, so installing AcyMailing with install_extension leaves a half-finished install. Install or update AcyMailing from Extensions > Install in the Joomla administrator; this add-on itself installs normally. Nothing here mails anyone by default: welcome, goodbye and double-opt-in emails each need an explicit flag, test sends need confirm: true, and queue_acym_campaign is a dry run unless you confirm it with the expected recipient count.

addons.name: MCP for AcyMailing Essential & Enterprise
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for AcyMailing Essential and Enterprise: scheduling, subscriber and link stats, segments, automations, follow-ups and custom fields.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Additive: install it alongside the free MCP for AcyMailing add-on, which covers everything AcyMailing Starter can do; the two share no tool name. Requires AcyMailing Essential or Enterprise, purchased from Acyba.

advisory.title: Needs AcyMailing Essential or Enterprise
advisory.message: Every tool runs AcyMailing's own edition check and refuses below its edition. On Starter only get_acym_pro_status works; Essential sites get scheduling and the detailed stats; segments, automations, follow-ups, scenarios, custom fields and mailbox actions need Enterprise. An expired trial counts as Starter. A Cybersalt membership buys the MCP tools, not Acyba's features. Scheduled campaigns only send if AcyMailing's cron is running. Install AcyMailing itself from the Joomla admin; its installer fails under install_extension.

addons.name: MCP for AdAgency Pro
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for iJoomla AdAgency Pro 7.x: list and approve campaigns / ads / advertisers, publish or unpublish, confirm orders, plus dashboard summary and performance reports.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow.

addons.name: MCP for Akeeba Backup Core
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Akeeba Backup Core — list profiles, list/inspect backup records, start and step backups, manage archives. Works against the same engine the admin UI uses.
addons.notes: Free — only useful on sites running Akeeba Backup Core (com_akeebabackup). Tools refuse cleanly on sites without it. Restore is intentionally NOT exposed: Akeeba Backup Core has no in-admin restore — restore is via the external Kickstart script, which an MCP tool can't usefully orchestrate.

addons.name: MCP for Akeeba Ticket System
addons.short_description: Drive Akeeba Ticket System from your MCP client: tickets, replies, collaborators, assignment, triage reports and health checks.
addons.notes: Free add-on - install it straight from this catalog. Works against both the Core and Professional editions of Akeeba Ticket System; the free Core edition is enough. Private manager notes are deliberately unreachable from this add-on, by design - see the release notes.

advisory.title: First release - here is exactly what has been tested
advisory.message: All 30 tools were driven end to end against a live Akeeba Ticket System 5.6.0 Core install on Joomla 6 before release - creating tickets, replying, assigning, inviting collaborators and deleting - and that testing is what caught and fixed a bug in the post-editing tool before it shipped. Two things have not been exercised yet. ATS Professional: the Pro-only surface (attachments, canned replies, auto-replies, manager notes, the Timecard, the Log, scheduling and the mail gateway) is detected via the vendor's own ATS_PRO constant and reported as locked, but that detection has only been proven against Core. And Joomla 5: the tools are written for it and one read path is specifically defensive about a Joomla 5 behaviour that is dormant on Joomla 6, but no Joomla 5 site has run them. If you are on either, everything should work - you would just be the first, so a good opening move is check_ats_health and a couple of the list tools before you drive any writes.

addons.name: MCP for Community Builder
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Community Builder: members, registration moderation, custom fields, profile tabs, connections, config and a sign-up email audit.
addons.notes: Free, because Community Builder core is free. CB core only: CB's paid add-ons (CB Paid Subscriptions, GroupJive, CB Gallery and the rest) are not covered.

advisory.title: CB emails are held back unless you ask for them
advisory.message: Approving, confirming, rejecting or banning a member through these tools does not email them unless you pass send_email: true; every email CB would have sent is returned in the response instead, so you can see it. When CB's "Generate Registration Passwords" is on, approving or confirming replaces the member's password and only the welcome email carries the new one, so those calls refuse without send_email. Deleting a CB field drops its column and every member's answer, so delete_cb_field asks for confirm_data_loss.

addons.name: MCP for Convert Forms
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Convert Forms: forms, individual form fields, submissions with answers resolved to their field labels, Tasks (email notifications and app integrations), connections and reporting. 30 tools.
addons.notes: Free add-on. Requires Convert Forms (com_convertforms) installed — the free edition is enough. It also runs correctly on Convert Forms Pro: the edition is detected at runtime, so Pro-only field types and apps light up automatically where they are present and are reported as locked where they are not. Pro-specific tooling ships separately as the MCP for Convert Forms Pro add-on.

advisory.title: Experimental — not yet exercised end-to-end on a live site
advisory.message: Built and statically verified against the Convert Forms 5.2.4 source, but not yet run against a live install. Every tool is lint- and resolution-checked and writes go through Convert Forms' own model and table classes, but no tool has been executed against real data. Read tools are safe to try; take a backup before using the write tools (create/update/delete forms, fields, submissions and tasks) on a production site.

addons.name: MCP for Convert Forms Pro
addons.short_description: Pro-only MCP tools for Convert Forms: submission export, visitor analytics (country / device / browser / source), app connection management, geo-IP lookup and maintenance. Installs the free base add-on alongside it.
addons.notes: This is a Joomla PACKAGE: installing it also installs the free MCP for Convert Forms Free add-on, which provides the 30-tool base surface (forms, fields, submissions, Tasks, reporting). The Pro plugin is additive — it adds 10 tools and duplicates none — so the two are designed to run together. Requires Convert Forms Pro on the site for the Pro tools to do anything; the base tools work on either edition. Paid add-on — install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow.

advisory.title: Experimental — not yet exercised end-to-end on a live site
advisory.message: Built and statically verified against the Convert Forms 5.2.4 Pro source, but no tool has yet been run against real data. Read tools (export, analytics, geo-IP lookup, connection test) are safe to try. Take a backup before using the write tools — connection create/update/delete and the uploaded-files cleaner, which deletes files from disk. Every tool detects the Convert Forms edition and reports plainly when it needs Pro rather than failing.

addons.name: MCP for Cookies Policy Notification Bar
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Cookies Policy Notification Bar: the bar's look and behaviour, cookie categories and declarations, texts, and a rendered-page check.
addons.notes: Free add-on - install it straight from this catalog. Works with CPNB 5.x, free or PRO; on the free build it refuses to write PRO settings (cookie blocking, consent logs, GeoIP). Dedicated PRO tools are in the separate MCP for Cookies Policy Notification Bar Pro add-on.

advisory.title: Tested against the PRO build of CPNB
advisory.message: Web357's free download of Cookies Policy Notification Bar is no longer available, so every tool was driven end to end against CPNB 5.1.2 PRO on Joomla 6.2. The free-edition paths (refusing PRO settings, default-language texts only) are covered by offline tests but have not run against a real free build. On an older free install, start with get_cpnb_component_info and check_cpnb_health.

addons.name: MCP for Cookies Policy Notification Bar Pro
addons.short_description: Adds the CPNB PRO tool surface: cookie blocking rules, consent logs and CSV export, GeoIP checks, multilingual texts and settings import/export.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Additive: the bar, categories, cookie declarations and default-language texts are in the free MCP for Cookies Policy Notification Bar add-on. Requires CPNB PRO, purchased from Web357.

advisory.title: Needs Cookies Policy Notification Bar PRO on the site
advisory.message: Every tool except get_cpnb_pro_status refuses unless CPNB PRO itself is installed. These are Web357's paid features and this add-on honours their gate, so a Cybersalt membership alone is not enough. Tested end to end against CPNB 5.1.2 PRO on Joomla 6.2, including real consent decisions made in a browser. Not yet tested with a second active site language.

addons.name: MCP for Cybersalt Release Manager
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for managing Cybersalt Release Manager — Packages, releases, installations, and activity log. Lets the MCP catalog inside cs-mcp-for-j dogfood itself.
addons.notes: Free — only useful on sites running cs-release-manager. Tools refuse cleanly on sites without it.

addons.name: MCP for DPCalendar
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for the full DPCalendar Core surface: calendars, events, bookings, tickets (with check-in/out), locations, coupons, external calendar feeds, tax rates, plus dashboard + revenue reports. ~43 tools.
addons.notes: Free add-on. Requires DPCalendar Core (com_dpcalendar) already installed on your site. Refuses cleanly on sites without it.

addons.name: MCP for EasyBlog
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for EasyBlog: posts, comments, moderation, subscribers, mail-queue inspection, custom fields and a site-wide health audit.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Requires EasyBlog itself, which is a separate product purchased from Stack Ideas. Reads a post's authored content from the revision layer rather than the intro/content columns, because those are a render cache with shortcodes already expanded.

advisory.title: Writes never send EasyBlog notification mail
advisory.message: By design, no tool in this add-on can send or queue EasyBlog mail. Publishing a post from Joomla's API application seeds the mail queue with broken permalinks - Uri::root() resolves to https://yoursite/api/ there, and it is cached independently of the application object - and EasyBlog drains that queue on ordinary front-end page loads by default, so the broken links would go out. Post saves therefore force skipNotifications and processAutopost off, and the transitions that notify are refused with an explanation: a post's FIRST publish, plus the pending and scheduled states. Re-publishing an already-published post IS allowed, because EasyBlog only notifies on the transition out of never-published. Do a post's first publish in the EasyBlog admin interface.

addons.name: MCP for Events Booking
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Events Booking: events, registrants, capacity and revenue reporting, and cross-event deduplicated mailing the component cannot do itself.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Requires Events Booking itself, which is a separate product purchased from JoomDonation. Tool names use the component's own eb_ table prefix rather than the add-on slug, because that is what an operator reading #__eb_registrants expects.

advisory.title: The mailing tool is the most heavily railed thing here - read this first
advisory.message: send_eb_deduplicated_mail is the one tool in this add-on that can do irreversible outward-facing damage, so dry_run defaults to true and confirm:true is required alongside dry_run:false. Sends are chunked with an explicit cursor, because Events Booking's own Mass Mail loops the entire recipient set in one synchronous request with no batching, no resume and without raising the time limit - and we refuse to inherit that. If a chunk fails mid-send the response says so plainly: batchMail has no transaction and reports no progress, so check the email log for that subject before retrying, or you risk sending twice. Quantify the audience with audit_eb_mass_mail_duplicates first - it is read-only and shows native send count versus deduplicated count, and exactly who would receive how many copies.

addons.name: MCP for FlexBanners
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for FlexBanners: banners, ad locations and modules, links, clients, sizes, click stats, and a check that says why a banner isn't showing.
addons.notes: Free, because FlexBanners is free. Built against FlexBanners 5.1.10 and checked against 6.0.05. Statistics are lifetime totals: FlexBanners keeps no per-day history.

advisory.title: On Joomla 6, FlexBanners itself needs the Backward Compatibility 6 plugin
advisory.message: FlexBanners 5.1.10 and 6.0.05 rely on code that Joomla 6 only provides through the core plugin "Behaviour - Backward Compatibility 6". With that plugin disabled, the FlexBanners component stops silently on load and any page showing a FlexBanners module fails with Class "JRoute" not found. Enable it under System > Plugins before using FlexBanners on Joomla 6. These MCP tools work either way, and check_flexbanners_health reports both problems.

addons.name: MCP for J2Commerce
addons.short_description: Run a J2Commerce 6 store from your MCP client: products, prices, stock, orders, customers, coupons, vouchers, reports and a tax audit.
addons.notes: Free, because J2Commerce 6 has no Pro edition gate. For J2Commerce 6 (com_j2commerce) on Joomla 6 only; J2Store 4 is a different product and is not covered. Tax and geozone settings are audited but deliberately never written.

advisory.title: First release - here is exactly what has been tested
advisory.message: All 43 tools were driven end to end against J2Commerce 6.6.5 on Joomla 6.2 before release, including a real storefront checkout: a product created by the add-on rendered and sold, a coupon created by the add-on applied at checkout, and cancelling and shipping the order moved stock correctly. Not yet exercised: variable, flexivariable, configurable and downloadable products, orders in more than one currency, and the links inside order emails sent from an AI request. If your store uses any of those, start with get_j2commerce_component_info and check_j2commerce_health, and use dry_run on set_j2commerce_order_status. Setting live_site in configuration.php is recommended so emailed links always point at your public site.

addons.name: MCP for JCE
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for JCE editor profiles: who gets which toolbar, per-plugin settings, and a security audit for rogue profiles.
addons.notes: Works with both the free and Pro editions of JCE and reports which it found. There is deliberately no separate Pro add-on: JCE Pro ships no database table of its own, so these tools already cover 100% of both editions' stored state.

advisory.title: Run the profile audit if this site predates JCE 2.9.99.5
advisory.message: CVE-2026-48907 (CVSS 10.0, CISA KEV, mass-exploited June 2026) let an unauthenticated attacker create a JCE editor profile permitting .php uploads, then upload a webshell. Updating JCE does NOT remove the attacker's profile row. audit_jce_profiles is a read-only check for exactly those indicators. This add-on has no profile-import tool, refuses executable extensions in upload types, and refuses all writes below 2.9.99.5.

addons.name: MCP for JSitemap Pro
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for JSitemap Pro: data sources, exclusions, priorities, config, precache, robots.txt, the /sitemap.xml redirect and IndexNow, all checked live.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Requires JSitemap Pro itself, which is a separate product purchased from Joomla! Extensions Store; there is no free JSitemap any more. Google Search Console submission is not included.

advisory.title: Needs JSitemap Pro on the site
advisory.message: This add-on does nothing without JSitemap Pro (com_jmap), a paid extension from Joomla! Extensions Store: every tool refuses with an explanation until it is installed. Tested end to end against JSitemap Pro 4.31.2 on Joomla 6.2, with every write checked in the database and in the live sitemap. Not yet exercised: multilingual sitemaps, datasets with content, and plugin or links source types. Search Console submission is left out because JSitemap's Google token cannot be used from the API application.

addons.name: MCP for Login as User
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Login as User: health, decoded permission rules, a target dry run, and audited, revocable one-time front-end login links.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Requires Login as User, purchased from Web357. Every tool is Super User only.

advisory.title: Link creation is off until you switch it on
advisory.message: create_loginasuser_link refuses until a person enables "Allow Login as User links over MCP" in this add-on's plugin options; installing or updating never turns it on. Super Users are refused as targets by default. A site owner can opt in through two plugin options, both off by default: "Allow backend users as targets" and, nested under it, "Allow Super User targets". Every link needs a stated reason, and the User Actions Log entry is written before the link exists. Links are Login as User's own: single use and valid for 5 minutes. Joomla's Clear Cache cancels pending links.

addons.name: MCP for Maximenu CK
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Maximenu CK: modules, styles and custom CSS, the compiled-CSS cache, mega-menu column layouts and a panel-overflow check.
addons.notes: Free add-on - install it straight from this catalog. Works with Maximenu CK Light and Pro and reports which it found. Writing per-item mega-menu settings (columns, widths, rows) is a Maximenu CK Pro feature and ships in the separate MCP for Maximenu CK Pro add-on.

advisory.title: Behind a CDN, purge the compiled CSS after a change
advisory.message: With Maximenu CK's "Load compiled CSS" on, the menu links maximenuck_<id>.css with no version query, so Cloudflare or a browser can keep serving the old file for weeks after a change. Every write tool returns the exact URL to purge, or set Load compiled CSS to No to inline the CSS. Per-item mega-menu settings are read here but not written; writing them needs Maximenu CK Pro and the Pro add-on.

addons.name: MCP for Maximenu CK Pro
addons.short_description: Adds the Maximenu CK Pro tool surface: per-item mega-menu settings and whole-dropdown column layouts that Light's own menu manager will not save.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. The base Maximenu CK tool surface is free and ships separately.

advisory.title: Needs Maximenu CK Pro on the target site
advisory.message: Every write tool refuses on Maximenu CK Light. Writing per-item mega-menu settings is the vendor's paid feature and this add-on honours their gate rather than writing the database directly to bypass it, so you also need Maximenu CK Pro from joomlack.fr. get_maximenuck_pro_status is deliberately ungated and says exactly what is missing. Tested on Maximenu CK Pro 10.2.0 and 10.3.0.

addons.name: MCP for Membership Pro
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Membership Pro: plans, subscriptions, subscribers, coupons, and the revenue, renewal and churn reporting the component does not offer.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Requires Membership Pro itself, which is a separate product purchased from JoomDonation. Tool names use an mp_ prefix rather than the add-on slug, so they read the way the tables do.

advisory.title: Read this before pointing the write tools at a live membership site
advisory.message: Version 1.0.0 has not yet been exercised against a live site. Every tool is written from a close reading of the Membership Pro 4.6.2 source and the add-on passes its full verification harness, but no tool has run against real subscriber data. The read and reporting tools are safe to explore with. Before using the 19 write tools on a site that takes money, take a backup. One thing worth knowing whatever you do: Membership Pro grants Joomla user groups through the plg_osmembership_joomlagroups plugin reacting to onMembershipActive, not through any column on the plan - so if that plugin is disabled, a subscription will look perfect in the admin list and grant nobody anything. Run check_mp_health first; it reports exactly that as a critical finding.

addons.name: MCP for Page Builder CK
addons.short_description: Adds Claude tools for Page Builder CK: pages, the block tree inside htmlcode, rows and columns, styles, saved elements, and the .pbck backup history.
addons.notes: Works with both the Light (free) and Pro editions of Page Builder CK and reports which one it found. Free add-on — no Cybersalt Pro membership needed. Export/import, the block library and presets are Page Builder CK Pro features and live in the separate Pro add-on.

advisory.title: Update Page Builder CK to 3.6.5 or later first
advisory.message: Page Builder CK below 3.6.5 carries known, actively exploited remote-code-execution flaws. CVE-2026-56290 (CVSS 10.0) is on the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list with public mass-exploitation tooling, and 3.6.0 only partially closed it — 3.6.3 and 3.6.5 fixed two further RCE/SQLi issues. These tools install and run either way, and will warn you, but patch first.

addons.name: MCP for Page Builder CK Pro
addons.short_description: Adds the Page Builder CK PRO tool surface: export and import of pages, elements, styles and content types, plus the saved-block library and presets.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. The base Page Builder CK tool surface is free and ships separately.

advisory.title: Needs Page Builder CK Pro on the target site
advisory.message: Every tool in this add-on refuses on a site running Page Builder CK Light. These are the vendor's paid features, and this add-on honours their gate rather than writing the database directly to bypass it — so a Cybersalt Pro membership alone is not enough, you also need Page Builder CK Pro from joomlack.fr. get_pagebuilderck_pro_status is deliberately ungated and will tell you exactly what is missing.

addons.name: MCP for RSTicketsPro
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for the RSTicketsPro ticket workflow: list, assign, reply, escalate, and resolve.
addons.notes: Paid add-on — install via Extensions → Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow.

addons.name: MCP for SP Page Builder
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for SP Page Builder: pages, the JSON content tree with surgical node edits, libraries, versions and a health audit.
addons.notes: Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow. Works with both the Free and Pro editions of SP Page Builder and reports which it found.

advisory.title: On the Free edition, most addons render as nothing
advisory.message: SP Page Builder Free renders 17 of its 68 addons. The other 51 ship no site.php, so a page referencing one renders as NOTHING — no error, no placeholder, no log line — and `heading` is one of them. Every write tool here refuses such a node by default rather than reporting success on a page that will come out blank. Note also that the vendor's own isProVersion() returns a hardcoded true in the FREE build, so this add-on reads the manifest variant instead.

addons.name: MCP for StageIt
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for StageIt staging-environment orchestration: status/prechecks/backups reads, plus chunked deploy/sync/remove/restore operations that resume across MCP calls when they run longer than the PHP execution budget.
addons.notes: Free — only useful on sites running StageIt. Tools refuse cleanly on sites without it. Long-running operations (deploy / sync / remove / restore) return a resume_token; call the continue_* variant with that token to drive the operation forward until it completes.

advisory.title: Experimental — server-timeout risk on large sites
advisory.message:
The StageIt MCP add-on is new and still in a testing phase. Long-running operations (deploy, sync, remove, restore) are broken into chunks that resume via continue_* tools, but they still run under Joomla's PHP execution budget on your server.

On large sites, or on shared hosting with tight PHP time limits, an operation driven through MCP may still time out mid-flight. If that happens, the situation is outside our control — the timeout is a function of your site size + host configuration. Recovery path: open the StageIt admin UI on your Joomla site directly and complete or roll back the operation from there.

We recommend testing this add-on on a non-production site first, or on a small site where the timeout risk is negligible. Feedback + timeout reports welcome at github.com/cybersalt/cs-mcp-for-j-addons-free/issues.

addons.name: MCP for Template Creator CK
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for Template Creator CK: inspect template projects, block structure, styles and fonts, audit generated output, and edit regeneration-safe CSS.
addons.notes: Template Creator CK builds templates in the browser from its editor canvas, so this add-on cannot trigger a regenerate: writes to the template project are inert until you click Apply in the TC CK editor, and every such tool says so in its response. For a CSS change that is live immediately AND survives regeneration, use write_templateck_custom_css. Paid add-on - install via Extensions > Install from URL with your download ID, until Phase 3 wires the in-catalog license flow.

advisory.title: Experimental — under active development
advisory.message: This add-on has not yet been exercised end-to-end on a live site. Read and diagnostic tools are safe to run. Writes are limited to template-project metadata, font metadata, and files inside Template Creator CK-generated template folders. Note that Template Creator CK regenerates a template in the browser, so this add-on cannot trigger a regenerate — changes written to the project are inert until you click Apply in the TC CK editor. Run check_templateck_health before regenerating: that step wipes templates/<name>/images/ and overwrites TC CK's own com_content overrides.

addons.name: MCP for VirtueMart
addons.short_description: Adds MCP tools for a VirtueMart shop: products, categories, pricing, stock, orders, customers, reviews and diagnostics.
addons.notes: Free, because VirtueMart is GPL with a single free edition. Component config is read-only on purpose, and media upload is deliberately not exposed.

advisory.title: Joomla 5 only, and update VirtueMart to 4.8.0
advisory.message: VirtueMart refuses to install on Joomla 6 — its own installer blocks it — so these tools report "not installed" on a J6 site. Separately, VirtueMart below 4.4.10 carries a documented one-click RCE chain (CVE-2025-6001 + CVE-2025-6002), and below 4.8.0 the bundled Skrill payment plugin has an unauthenticated order-status bypass that the vendor says to fix by updating or removing the plugin. No CVE was assigned for that one, so vulnerability feeds will not warn you.

addons.name: MCP for VMT + ET Templates
addons.short_description: Finds VirtueMart template overrides that have silently gone stale, plus template inventory and validated parameter writes.
addons.notes: Free companion add-on for Cybersalt VMT/ET template customers. Install from Browse MCP Add-Ons. Wraps Cybersalt's own VMT and ET templates; refuses cleanly on a site with none installed.

advisory.title: What this is actually for
advisory.message: A VMT template ships frozen copies of VirtueMart core view files. When VirtueMart updates, those copies rot with no error and no log entry: either the shop never gains a new feature, or a renamed helper white-screens a page. check_vmtet_override_drift compares every override against the core file it shadows. Nothing in Joomla or VirtueMart will tell you which have gone stale.
